Not what the package said.
Aug 2016 • Couples
Just got back from a cruise on this boat with my girlfriend. 

The good: driver was on time, nice clean pickup car and the food was great. 

The bad: We arrived on time thanks to our nice smiley driver. (Wasnt English speaking as advertised- not a big deal). We board the boat at 7:15, and waited on another couple to arrive. We waited 20 minutes and they still hadn't arrived so we were asked to start eating so the food didn't go cold while the boat was still moored. They then arrived and we took off at 7:45pm. 10 minutes into the trip we had an apology from a staff member about the delay. We asked her if the 2 hour cruise would just finish later then. .She said no because others need to be back by 9pm. We arrived and out of the boat by 8:50

Cant help but feel we only got half of what we paid for. One hour cruise total time was not how this dinner was advertised.

A Great Evening
Dec 2015 • Family
Agreed with another reviewer about being disappointed that the BBQ dinner was not. However, the buffet (hot food 1st round followed by dessert) was very tasty and sufficient, bearing in mind that part of the cost covers the cruise as well. Service by the manager and boat staff is excellent and my family found this to be a great way to spend a leisurely evening in Saigon. The boat is very clean and very well refurbished and the live traditional music played on board is charming. Cool breezes (with the help of a fan), slow steady cruising and city lights all add in to make this a great evening.

BBQ Dinner Cruise experiment
Apr 2015 • Friends
I have had dinners and have been on cruises before, but as the title suggests, this is my first time attending a dinner cruise as a stand-alone program. Despite not having any relatively similar example to compare to, the experience on board Lady Hau was quite impressive. 
The take off time at 7:45 pm was well planned out to allow guests time to freshen up after a long day. The time frame of the trip was just right, sufficiently long to provide a relaxing dinning experience without excessively lengthy. This was rather helpful since there were many things to appreciate while on board beside the foods, such as the beautiful surrounding scenery including Saigon Skyline, bridges, the river and not to mention great musical performances from the crews. Nevertheless, the foods were fantastic to say the least. There was a buffet with a great variety of Vietnamese dishes and salads. Plates and plates of BBQ were brought right over to everyone's tables as the grilling was just finished and the aroma filled the air beautifully. 
Overall, since the cruise is available for booking throughout the week, it's great for treating visitors to Saigon or for hanging out with friends and family.

Laid back feel with high-class service/dinner
Mar 2015 • Friends
I took the Lady Hau with some girlfriends one evening and was impressed the moment I set foot on the beautifully yet modestly decorated boat. The selection of food was great--with key Vietnamese items and really nice fresh seafood--some of the best I've had in the city lately. The wait staff was also perfect--attentive but not bothersome, letting my friends and I enjoy our dinner/chat/glasses of wine. 

Although I went for dinner with some friends, the ambience is great in that it offers a few options--you could do a romantic dinner there, a big group meal on the upper deck, or even make a night of seated/standing mingling cocktails on the front of the boat.

A very relaxing float down the Saigon River without any of the commotion you might find from other boat cruises.

The boat has two open ends, but covered in the middle, which is ideal during the intermittent rainy season underway!

Wedding Anniversary Cruise
Oct 2014 • Couples
I've lived in VN for over 5 years, and this cruise was an experience I won't forget. We booked a dinner cruise for our anniversary and turned out that on the day, we were the only two people on the boat....the experience was magical. The cruise is operated by a hotel company - so the service was impeccable from start to finish. We did request a mainly seafood spread and it was readily made available and was really tasty. The best part is that they don't take you where every other dinner cruise boat goes - actually, in the exact opposite direction so you get maximum quiet and actually see the life on the river/banks while you pass. The boat has a really nice open area at the bow and they serve your drinks there. For the price you pay - this is one of the best value dinners, let alone a cruise - its almost like you pay for a great dinner, with the cruise thrown in for free!

Definitely a must do for any visitor and would also be a great business entertainment idea for 20 or so people.

I will add that the boat is ULTRA safe (unlike the others on the Saigon River), its new and has all the safety precautions clearly marked and visible - they actually brief you on it when you board.

To top it all off - the crew had prepared a cake for our anniversary also! that was a super touch!

We wont wait for an anniversary to do this again!
